narrative: A [[member]] signs up and logs in through [[auth]], with a code sent by [[svc-resend]], a passkey, or [[github]].
Once in, they write [[notes]] and look after their [[settings|profile and security]].
The [[server]] keeps their data in the database and reports errors to [[svc-sentry]].

tours.title: Logging in
captions: The /login page, a React Router route, checks the form in its action, then hands the user to the login helper.
The helper asks for a two-factor code when it's turned on, otherwise it starts the session.
The auth helper checks the password and creates a session row in the database.

tours.title: Saving a note
captions: The /users/:username/notes/new page shows the form; its action is the shared note editor's, re-exported, so the form posts there.
The shared action, used by both the new and edit routes, checks you own the notes and uploads any images first.
Then it saves the note and its images through the shared Prisma client.

tours.title: Logging in with GitHub
captions: The GitHub button posts to the /auth/:provider resource route, which asks the auth helper for the provider named in the URL.
Connections maps each provider name to its implementation.
The GitHub provider redirects to GitHub and, on the way back, reads the user's profile.

tours.title: Resetting a password
captions: The /forgot-password page finds the account and prepares a one-time code.
It emails the code through Resend, and the user verifies it to set a new password.
